chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazal, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Fazl Abu al-Abbas al-Baqbaaq, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The mother is not barred from the third except by two brothers or four sisters of the father and mother, or of the father.

key_terms.لِأَبٍ وَأُمٍّ: Of the father and mother (full siblings)

ai.seo_question: When is the mother's share of inheritance reduced from one-third to one-sixth in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the specific conditions under which the mother’s share is reduced from one-third to one-sixth due to the presence of multiple siblings. It distinguishes between full and paternal siblings, noting that two brothers or four sisters (of the father or both parents) trigger this exclusion, a nuance critical in Shia fiqh for resolving conflicts between parental and sibling heirs. The ruling underscores the hierarchical priority of the mother’s claim over that of siblings, except in these defined numerical thresholds.
